cohort_rules.G1_Pure_Consumer: information consumption without substantive original contribution under frozen codebook
cohort_rules.G2_Low_Producer: limited original contribution under frozen codebook
cohort_rules.G3_High_Producer: substantive original contribution or synthesis under frozen codebook
cohort_rules.G4_Iterative_Researcher: preregistered iterative research trajectory with temporal refinement
cohort_rules.G6_Synthetic_AI: declared synthetic/AI agent with fixed versioned generation protocol
cohort_rules.G7_Human_Expert: human satisfying preregistered expert qualification independently of outcomes

independence_constraints: one analytical unit belongs to exactly one cohort
one stable privacy-preserving unit_id per analytical unit
nested records are clustered and not treated as independent units
